_note: Names used in titles, tags, filters and translations. Only the main session edits this file (scouts propose new teams inline). Arabic and Hebrew names must be reviewed by the owner before first use in a published product. Leagues, teams, styles and players added on 2026-09-26 come from catalog/classification.json (same he/en/ar names; scripts/catalog/classify.mjs warns on a mismatch). Those teams have no 'code' yet: give one (3 letters) the first time a product file uses the team.

Football Kit.note: Kids sets: jersey + shorts (owner, 2026-09-26). Titles add the kids suffix.

Hoodie.note: The NFL hoodies imported by the owner (titles such as 'סווטשירט קפוצ׳ון אטלנטה פאלקונס לגברים ירוק זית 2025'). New hoodies need owner approval.

title_rules.kit_suffix: Empty for kit=home. Otherwise ' – ' + kit name (he/en/ar). Used by basketball types only.
title_rules.season_format: Short form in titles (26/27), long form in handles and tags (2026-27).

kids_jerseyxie.note: Kids products from the supplier jerseyxie use its own sizes and chart (owner decision, 2026-09-26). Full chart: catalog/size-charts/jerseyxie.json.

kids.note: Brand labels (Nike YXS-YXL, adidas 116-164, ...) are kept in source_size_label and mapped to these buckets; inexact mappings are flagged for the owner. Used for other sources only; jerseyxie kids products use kids_jerseyxie.
